exposure: fetal occiput posterior position beyond 3 hours
cohort: Primiparous women at term with a singleton, cephalic fetus and a passive second stage of labor prolonged over 3 hours before pushing
finding: Maternal BMI > 30, suspected fetal macrosomia, induction by prostaglandins, stagnation of cervical dilation, and fetal occiput posterior position beyond 3 hours were associated with increased risk of cesarean delivery for unengaged fetal head after 3 hours of delayed pushing.
